houseIntro: The House of the MealThree ways of knowingAt Nexus Grythyttan, Campus, you take courses in the House of the Meal. The knowledge you train and are tested in builds on a modern reading of Aristotle’s concepts of knowledge:Episteme: to know.Techne: to be able to do.Phronesis: to be able to judge.Knowing is not enough. The one who can moves between analysis and experience, between experience and judgement, and acts.It is in the concrete situation that knowledge shows itself. Do you have what it takes?Read more→ The knowledge foundation in MåltidsbiblioteketTo the pavilions→
